artifacts.notes: Exact PDF acquired and hashed in run-scoped temporary storage, then inspected by page image. PDF p. 72 displays fols. 68v and 69r; p. 81 displays fols. 77v and 78r; p. 128 displays fols. 124v and 125r; p. 129 displays fols. 125v and 126r. The scan has no text layer. PDF-page coordinates refer to this exact artifact, not printed pagination.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Jagiellonian Digital Library record states Domena publiczna (public domain) for this manuscript scan. The 110,899,733-byte official PDF is not duplicated in the repository.
